where.if: and (no like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or erp_no like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or model like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or sn like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or user_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or exists (select 1 from sys_user u where u.id in (it_asset.user_id,it_asset.borrower_id) and (u.name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or u.employee_no = #{keyword})))

mapper.sql: order by case status when '借出中' then 0 when '闲置' then 1 when '在用' then 2 when '维修中' then 3 else 4 end, no
mapper.select: select count(*) from it_asset where status = #{status}
